_meta.title: FLUX.3 Klein Distilled T2I
_meta.description: Step-distilled checkpoint, official ComfyUI template settings: 16 steps (4-16), CFG 1, euler/simple. REQUIRES (gated, accept the BFL license on HF first): black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein-comfy diffusion_models/flux3-image-klein-int8-convrot.safetensors (5.8 GB, CUDA), saved as diffusion_models/flux3_image_klein_sd_int8_convrot.safetensors; on Apple Silicon use diffusion_models/flux3-image-klein-bf16.safetensors (the step-distilled checkpoint, despite the name) saved as diffusion_models/flux3_image_klein_sd_bf16.safetensors, which the app picks automatically when int8 is missing, plus text_encoders/qwen3vl_4b_bf16.safetensors (CLIP type flux3) and vae/flux2-vae.safetensors from the same repo. bf16 on Apple Silicon (int8_convrot/nvfp4 are CUDA paths). The official template runs the Qwen3.5 9B prompt upsampler first; this graph skips it, so write a full scene caption (subject, framing, background, lighting).
